description: Search the AgentIndex for AI agents, MCP servers, A2A agents, and x402-gated APIs by capability keyword. Returns ranked results with type, description, URL, and tags. FREE for the first 50 calls a day per caller, then $0.005 in USDC on base via x402. Over the allowance, call without `payment` to receive the exact payment requirements, then call again with `payment` to be served.

capability.description: Capability or keyword to search (e.g. trading, data retrieval, mcp)

payment.description: Optional. An x402 X-PAYMENT header value, needed only past the free daily allowance.

type.description: Filter by resource type: application/mcp-server-card+json, application/ai-skill, application/openapi+json, etc.

name: search_agents
